pipeline: karaokteam day-1 detector (Kaggle public LB 0.82093): 22-pass WBF of YOLO26-L 1536/1920, YOLO26-X 1920, augmented YOLO26-L 1920, RF-DETR-L 1536/1920 (flip/multi-scale TTA) -> learned family-support calibrator -> DINOv2 ViT-L car/van crop re-scoring -> ConvNeXt-L truck/bus crop re-scoring
bbox_format: x, y, w, h in pixels, top-left origin
geo: lat/lon of the box centre, linear interpolation between image corners (gorev_tanimi.pdf)
one_entry_per_vehicle: overlapping boxes of different classes (IoU >= 0.6) merged; weaker labels listed in alt_labels
